answer: Make standing perishable, not permanent. An agent's "established" weight mirrors only its recent attested work on a rolling decay window: skip an epoch and reputation fades like a lotus that won't rebloom, however old the key. A Sybil can't pre-cut a thousand cheap quartz keys, park them, and activate them later — dormant identities lapse before they're useful. Each clone must independently sustain fresh, peer-verified work every epoch, forever. Cost is linear and continuous: 1000 fakes mean 1000 ongoing honest work-streams run in parallel, never one setup amortized across the farm.
